ideas.pitch: An open-source media asset management dashboard that uses Cloudinary's AI tagging and transformation APIs to auto-organize community event media.
ideas.title: CloudinaryLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the mandatory Cloudinary integration requirement while solving the messy media management problem that hackathon organizers face when collecting event photos.

ideas.pitch: A developer tool that automatically turns code commit histories and PR descriptions into structured Notion documentation pages, satisfying the hackathon's core Notion requirement.
ideas.title: NotionSync CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the strict Notion documentation requirement with an automated utility makes it extremely easy for judges to verify that the team successfully met the submission criteria.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable AI code reviewer that analyzes incoming pull requests for open-source repositories and leaves structured comments using Cloudinary for architecture diagram generation.
ideas.title: OpenSourcePR Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of solving a genuine developer pain point while incorporating the mandatory Cloudinary stack requirement for visual asset generation.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that accepts natural language prompts to search, transform, and optimize media libraries stored via Cloudinary.
ideas.title: MediaVault Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge AI agent workflows with the mandatory Cloudinary sponsor technology, maximizing impact for technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A live building journey tracker that automatically syncs markdown progress updates from a development environment directly into a formatted Notion database.
ideas.title: DocuStream
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns perfectly with the SheBuilds open-source building theme and satisfies the mandatory Notion documentation requirement by eating its own dog food.
